name: smv7/smarty-asset-bundle
description: Asset bundle combiner and minifier for Smarty 5.7.0 with HTTP/3 preload support and APCu learning system

scripts.check-apcu: @php -r "if (!extension_loaded('apcu')) { echo 'ERROR: APCu extension is required!'; exit(1); } echo 'APCu extension is loaded.';"
post-install-cmd:
@php -r "if (!extension_loaded('apcu')) { echo '
\033[1;31mERROR: APCu extension is required for smv7/smarty-asset-bundle\033[0m
'; echo 'Please install APCu: https://www.php.net/manual/en/apcu.installation.php
'; exit(1); }"
post-update-cmd:
@php -r "if (!extension_loaded('apcu')) { echo '
\033[1;31mERROR: APCu extension is required for smv7/smarty-asset-bundle\033[0m
'; echo 'Please install APCu: https://www.php.net/manual/en/apcu.installation.php
'; exit(1); }"
